world.title: Commonwealth Raises $1 Billion to Accelerate Path to Commercial Fusion Energy
world.excerpt: Commonwealth Fusion Energy (CFS) announced that it has raised $1 billion in equity funding in a new financing round aimed at accelerating its progress towards commercialization of its fusion energy technology, with the company targeting putting power on the grid in the early 2030s. The new funding round is the largest in the fusion industry since CFS’ $1.8 billion round in 2021, according to the company, and brings Commonwealth’s total capital raised to $4 billion, representing approximately 30% of the total capital raised by the fusion industry to-date.
